usage: agentware plan claim [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                            [--actor {operator,loop}] [--handle HANDLE]
                            [--host HOST] [--now NOW]
                            feature

positional arguments:
  feature               feature slug; dir under work/

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --actor {operator,loop}
                        requesting actor
  --handle HANDLE       claim handle
  --host HOST           claim host
  --now NOW             ISO ts override (tests)
